import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static long binpow(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        a %= MOD;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        long inv100 = binpow(100, MOD - 2);
        long[][] prob = new long[2 * n][2 * n];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                long x = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
                prob[i][j + n] = (x * inv100) % MOD;
            }
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(prob[0][1]);
            return;
        }

        int half1 = n / 2;
        int half2 = n - half1;

        List<Integer> left1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> left2 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> right = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < half1; ++i) left1.add(i);
        for (int i = half1; i < n; ++i) left2.add(i);
        for (int i = n; i < 2 * n; ++i) right.add(i);

        List<Integer> subsets1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> subsets2 = new ArrayList<>();
        int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
        int[] idx0 = new int[1 << n];
        int[] idx1 = new int[1 << n];
        Arrays.fill(idx0, -1);
        Arrays.fill(idx1, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == half1) {
                idx0[mask] = cnt1++;
                subsets1.add(mask);
            }
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == half2) {
                idx1[mask] = cnt2++;
                subsets2.add(mask);
            }
        }

        int[] f_arr = new int[1 << cnt1];
        int[] g_arr = new int[1 << cnt2];
        boolean[][] adj = new boolean[2 * n][2 * n];

        compute(f_arr, left1, right, subsets1, idx0, prob, n);
        compute(g_arr, left2, right, subsets2, idx1, prob, n);

        for (int i = 0; i < cnt1; ++i) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << cnt1); ++mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    f_arr[mask] = (f_arr[mask] + f_arr[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        int[] rev_map = new int[cnt2];
        for (int i = 0; i < cnt2; ++i) {
            int mask = subsets2.get(i);
            int complement = ((1 << n) - 1) ^ mask;
            rev_map[i] = idx0[complement];
        }

        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << cnt2); ++mask) {
            int complement = (1 << cnt2) - 1 - mask;
            int rev_mask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < cnt2; ++i) {
                if ((complement & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    rev_mask |= (1 << rev_map[i]);
                }
            }

            int inv_complement = ((1 << cnt1) - 1) ^ rev_mask;
            long weight = (1 - f_arr[inv_complement] + MOD) % MOD;
            ans = (ans + weight * g_arr[mask]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void compute(int[] out, List<Integer> L, List<Integer> R, List<Integer> subgs, int[] idx_map, long[][] prob, int n) {
        List<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int u : L) {
            for (int v : R) {
                edges.add(new int[]{u, v});
            }
        }
        int m = edges.size();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << m); ++mask) {
            long weight = 1;
            boolean[][] adj = new boolean[2 * n][2 * n];
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                int u = edges.get(i)[0], v = edges.get(i)[1];
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    weight = (weight * prob[u][v]) % MOD;
                    adj[u][v] = true;
                } else {
                    weight = (weight * ((1 - prob[u][v] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    adj[u][v] = false;
                }
            }

            int new_mask = 0;
            for (int gr : subgs) {
                List<Integer> perm = new ArrayList<>(L);
                List<Integer> idxs = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if ((gr & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        idxs.add(i + n);
                    }
                }

                Collections.sort(idxs);
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < perm.size(); ++i) {
                        if (!adj[perm.get(i)][idxs.get(i)]) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(idxs));
                if (found) {
                    new_mask |= (1 << idx_map[gr]);
                }
            }
            out[new_mask] = (int)((out[new_mask] + weight) % MOD);
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> array) {
        int i = array.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array.get(i) >= array.get(i + 1)) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = array.size() - 1;
        while (array.get(j) <= array.get(i)) {
            j--;
        }
        Collections.swap(array, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(array.subList(i + 1, array.size()));
        return true;
    }
}
